caseName: LFP Publishing Group, LLC v. Toffoloni
caseNameFull: LFP Publishing Group, LLC, dba Hustler Magazine v. Maureen Toffoloni, Administrator and Personal Representative of the Estate of Nancy E. Benoit

opinions.text:
Motion of The Reporters Committee for Freedom of the Press, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of First Amend*207ment Lawyers Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit denied.
